datasets.name: clientes_detalle
queryLines:
WITH fact AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(nis AS STRING) AS NISE,
    MAX(nombre_factura) AS nombre_factura
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        nis,
        nombre_factura
      FROM
        datosami.datos.tmt
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        nis,
        nombre_factura
      FROM
        datosami.datos.tmtb
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  e.PRIORIDAD,
  e.NISE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.NOMBRE_ABONADO), ''), f.nombre_factura, 'Sin nombre') AS CLIENTE,
  CONCAT(
    LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.NOMBRE_ABONADO), ''), f.nombre_factura, 'Sin nombre'), 30),
    ' (',
    e.NISE,
    ')'
  ) AS CLIENTE_NISE,
  s.DESC_TIPO_CIU AS ACTIVIDAD,
  e.PLAN,
  ROUND(e.KWP, 1) AS KWP,
  ROUND(e.E1_MARGEN_ANUAL_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E1_MARGEN_ANUAL_M,
  ROUND(e.E1_VAN_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E1_VAN_M,
  ROUND(e.CAPEX_SOLAR_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS CAPEX_SOLAR_M,
  ROUND(e.E2_VAN_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E2_VAN_M,
  ROUND(e.E2_RBC, 3) AS E2_RBC,
  COALESCE(e.BESS_ESCENARIO_OPTIMO, 'SIN_BESS') AS BESS_OPTIMO,
  ROUND(e.BESS_VAN_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS BESS_VAN_M,
  ROUND(e.E2B_CAPEX_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E2B_CAPEX_M,
  ROUND(e.E2B_VAN_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E2B_VAN_M,
  ROUND(e.E2B_TIR_PCT, 2) AS E2B_TIR_PCT,
  ROUND(e.E2B_RBC, 3) AS E2B_RBC,
  e.E2B_VIABLE,
  ROUND(e.VALOR_ACTUAR_PRIMERO_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS VALOR_ACTUAR_PRIMERO_M
FROM
  datosami.datos.financiero_cliente_escenarios e
    LEFT JOIN datosami.datos.clientes_base_plata_clientes s
      ON s.NISE = e.NISE
    LEFT JOIN fact f
      ON f.NISE = e.NISE
ORDER BY
  e.PRIORIDAD

datasets.name: matriz
queryLines:
SELECT ESTRATEGIA, PENETRACION, CONCAT(CAST(CAST(PENETRACION * 100 AS INT) AS STRING), '% adopta') AS PENETRACION_TXT, CAPTURA_CNFL,
CLIENTES_ADOPTAN, CLIENTES_CNFL, CLIENTES_AUTOINSTALAN,
VAN_E1_CRC / 1e6 AS VAN_E1_M, VAN_E2_CRC / 1e6 AS VAN_E2_M, VAN_TOTAL_CRC / 1e6 AS VAN_TOTAL_M,
GANANCIA_VS_NO_ACTUAR_CRC / 1e6 AS GANANCIA_VS_NO_ACTUAR_M, CAPEX_E2_CRC / 1e6 AS CAPEX_E2_M, TIR_E2_PCT, RBC_E2
FROM datosami.datos.financiero_matriz_adopcion

datasets.name: bess
queryLines:
SELECT ESCENARIO_BATERIA, CLIENTES, CLIENTES_VAN_POSITIVO, ROUND(CAPACIDAD_KWH / 1e3, 1) AS CAPACIDAD_MWH,
ROUND(AHORRO_ENERGIA_ANUAL_CRC / 1e6, 1) AS AHORRO_ENERGIA_M, ROUND(AHORRO_POTENCIA_ANUAL_CRC / 1e6, 1) AS AHORRO_POTENCIA_M,
ROUND(CAPEX_CRC / 1e6, 1) AS CAPEX_M, ROUND(VAN_CRC / 1e6, 1) AS VAN_M, ROUND(TIR_PCT, 2) AS TIR_PCT, ROUND(RBC, 3) AS RBC,
ROUND(VAN_SOLO_POSITIVOS_CRC / 1e6, 1) AS VAN_SOLO_POSITIVOS_M
FROM datosami.datos.financiero_bess_marginal

datasets.name: supuestos
queryLines:
SELECT 'Parametro' AS TIPO, PARAMETRO AS NOMBRE, CAST(VALOR AS STRING) AS VALOR, UNIDAD, FUENTE FROM datosami.datos.parametros_estudio_financiero
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tarifa', CONCAT(PLAN, ' ', FRANJA), CONCAT('venta ', CAST(ROUND(TARIFA_VENTA_ENERGIA_CAL, 2) AS STRING), ' / compra+peaje ', CAST(ROUND(TARIFA_COMPRA_ENERGIA + PEAJE_TRANSMISION, 2) AS STRING), ' CRC/kWh; potencia venta ', CAST(TARIFA_VENTA_POTENCIA AS STRING), ' / compra ', CAST(TARIFA_COMPRA_POTENCIA AS STRING), ' CRC/kW'), 'CRC', 'consolidado_tarifas_28102026.pdf; config.py con CVG'
FROM datosami.datos.tarifas_franja_estudio

datasets.name: calidad
queryLines: SELECT VALIDACION, DESCRIPCION, REGISTROS_AFECTADOS, FECHA_VALIDACION FROM datosami.datos.financiero_calidad

datasets.name: curvas_cliente
queryLines:
WITH fact AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(nis AS STRING) AS NISE,
    MAX(nombre_factura) AS nombre_factura
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        nis,
        nombre_factura
      FROM
        datosami.datos.tmt
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        nis,
        nombre_factura
      FROM
        datosami.datos.tmtb
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
),
esc AS (
  SELECT
    NISE,
    COALESCE(BESS_ESCENARIO_OPTIMO, 'SIN_BESS') AS BESS_OPTIMO, PRIORIDAD, ROUND(E2B_VAN_CRC / 1e6, 2) AS E2B_VAN_M
  FROM
    datosami.datos.financiero_cliente_escenarios
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    e.BESS_OPTIMO, e.PRIORIDAD, e.E2B_VAN_M,
    CONCAT(
      LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.NOMBRE_ABONADO), ''), f.nombre_factura, 'Sin nombre'), 30),
      ' (',
      i.NISE,
      ')'
    ) AS CLIENTE_NISE
  FROM
    datosami.datos.bateria_despacho_optimo_intervalo i
      JOIN esc e
        ON e.NISE = i.NISE
      LEFT JOIN datosami.datos.clientes_base_plata_clientes s
        ON s.NISE = i.NISE
      LEFT JOIN fact f
        ON f.NISE = i.NISE
  WHERE i.ESTADO_LP = 'OPTIMO'
)
SELECT
  b.NISE,
  b.PLAN,
  b.CLIENTE_NISE,
  'ADOPCION_100' AS ESCENARIO_SOLAR,
  b.ESCENARIO_BATERIA,
  b.BESS_OPTIMO, b.PRIORIDAD, b.E2B_VAN_M,
  CASE
    WHEN b.ESCENARIO_BATERIA = b.BESS_OPTIMO THEN 'Si'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS ES_BESS_OPTIMO,
  b.TIPO_DIA,
  b.PERIODO_MES,
  DATE_FORMAT(b.PERIODO_MES, 'yyyy-MM') AS MES_TXT,
  b.HORA + b.MINUTO / 60.0 AS HORA_DEC,
  b.BLOQUE_15M,
  u.SERIE,
  u.KW
FROM
  b
  LATERAL VIEW
    STACK(
      5,
      '1 Demanda base',
      b.DEMANDA_KWH * 4,
      '2 Generacion solar',
      b.GENERACION_SOLAR_KWH * 4,
      '3 Neta con solar (red)',
      b.NETO_SIN_BESS_KWH * 4,
      '4 Neta con solar + BESS (red)',
      b.NETO_CON_BESS_KWH * 4,
      '5 BESS (+descarga / -carga)',
      (b.DESCARGA_KWH - b.CARGA_KWH) * 4
    ) u
    AS SERIE, KW

lines: **E1**: el cliente instala solar (impacto en el margen de CNFL). **E2**: CNFL instala solar (y BESS con despacho optimo) en el cliente. VAN a 10 anios (tasa 8.97%), montos en millones de CRC, anualizados de 7 meses (abr-oct 2026). Compra con CVG; venta con tarifas maximas vigentes.
